RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel alone is not evidence of bias, particularly in healthcare where women constitute a significant proportion of the workforce. For department head positions, selection committees routinely prioritize broad organizational leadership, management training, and interview performance over higher academic credentials such as a PhD. 

Furthermore, a two-week turnaround for formal written feedback is standard in institutional HR processes. Raising the panel's gender composition without concrete evidence of discriminatory remarks or procedural violations will appear defensive and could severely damage professional relationships and future promotional prospects. Instead, follow up politely on your feedback request, focusing entirely on objective competencies, interview feedback, and constructive areas for professional development.
